priorityList.notes: A heal between pulls instead of eating.
Sit down to eat and drink when health or mana is low.
A heal in combat when health runs low.
Pull the mob we found with a shock once it's in range.
Walk up to the mob we found, into shock range or until it notices us.
Look for another mob while fighting: the next pull, now or after a rest. We stand and keep fighting while we look.
Stoneskin Totem in combat. It takes a few points off every mob swing.
Searing Totem with enough mobs pulled.
Stormstrike on cooldown. Without the talent ignore the warning on this line.
Earth Shock otherwise.
Fire Nova with two mobs on us, around the fire totem.
Lightning Shield whenever it is down.
Racials and trinkets in combat.
